name: What tools are needed for handheld showerhead installation?

mainEntity.name: What tools are needed for handheld showerhead installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a standard handheld showerhead installation, common tools include an adjustable wrench, plumber's tape (Teflon tape), and possibly pliers. If your installation requires drilling new holes for a wall-mounted bracket, you will also need a drill with appropriate drill bits (e.g., tile bits for ceramic or porcelain). A utility knife may be useful for opening packaging. For complex installations, specialized plumbing tools might be necessary, which a professional contractor would possess.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basic tools include an adjustable wrench and plumber's tape. Drilling tools are needed for wall-mounted brackets.
